component.name: omfp
component.summary: Many oh-my-pi coding agents at once, from the browser or the desktop

description.p: A browser and desktop app for the oh-my-pi coding agent: many conversations with the agent at once, each with its own oh-my-pi running in the background, in workspaces that stay. The agent can build the panels around the chat itself.
oh-my-pi runs on your machine, outside the sandbox, so it can use your git, shells and build tools.
